Listen to this article Share Edo Queens will begin their title defence against Rivers Angels on Tuesday as the 2026/27 Nigeria Women Football League (NWFL) Premiership season gets underway at the Samuel Ogbemudia Stadium, Benin City. Advertisement Advertisement The opening encounter will headline Matchday One, with the remaining fixtures scheduled for Wednesday. Modupe Shabu, NWFL chief operating officer, announced the fixtures following the league’s Annual General Meeting (AGM) on Thursday. Edo Queens, who won the 2025/26 title, face a familiar challenge in Rivers Angels, one of the established sides in Nigerian women’s football. The defending champions will be seeking a winning start as they begin their bid to retain the crown. The 16 participating clubs have been divided into two groups of eight. Group A features Edo Queens, Rangers International Women, Rivers Angels, Abia Angels, Adamawa Queens, FC Robo Queens, Ahudiyannem Queens and Sunshine Queens. Advertisement Group B comprises Bayelsa Queens, Remo Stars Ladies, Nasarawa Amazons, Delta Queens, Heartland Queens, Ekiti Queens, Pelican Stars and Ibom Angels. Wednesday’s Group A fixtures will see Rangers International Women host FC Robo Queens, Abia Angels take on Ahudiyannem Queens, while Adamawa Queens face Sunshine Queens. Advertisement In Group B, Bayelsa Queens will welcome Nasarawa Amazons, Ibom Angels will meet Pelican Stars, and Heartland Queens will take on Ekiti Queens. The league calendar also includes scheduled breaks to accommodate the festive period and other activities during the campaign. Advertisement Advertisement The Christmas break will run from December 23, 2026, to January 13, 2027, while the mid-season break is scheduled for January 28 to February 3, 2027. A further break for the Salah period will run from February 3 to March 17, 2027.
